name: YTLPOWR
recent: YTL Power 在 2026 年 11 月 19 日公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度业绩，营收环比增长 19.3%，同比增长 40.7%，但净利同比下滑 8.0%。同期，公司因雇员公积金局 (EPF) 连续多日申报持股变动，以及凭单转换和 ESOS 行使而多次发布附加上市公告。
notable: 雇员公积金局 (EPF) 在 2026 年 11 月多次申报持股变动。
公司因凭单转换为普通股及 ESOS 行使而多次发行新股并发布附加上市公告。
公司公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度业绩，营收环比增长 19.3%，同比增长 40.7%。
risks: 季度净利同比下滑 8.0%，净利率由 6.7% 降至 6.1%。
凭单转换及 ESOS 行使持续增加已发行股本，可能摊薄每股盈利。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度，营收为 MYR 7,543,438,000，环比增长 19.3%，同比增长 40.7%；净利为 MYR 460,619,000，环比增长 8.8%，但同比下滑 8.0%；净利率为 6.1%，低于上一季度的 6.7%。

recent_en: YTL Power released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 19 November 2026, with revenue up 19.3% QoQ and 40.7% YoY, while net income fell 8.0% YoY. During the same period, the company issued multiple additional listing announcements due to warrant conversions and ESOS exercises, alongside consecutive EPF shareholding change filings.
notable_en: The Employees Provident Fund Board (EPF) filed multiple shareholding change notices in November 2026.
The company issued new shares and made multiple additional listing announcements following warrant conversions to ordinary shares and ESOS exercises.
The company announced its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026, with revenue up 19.3% QoQ and 40.7% YoY.
risks_en: Net income fell 8.0% YoY for the quarter, with net margin declining from 6.7% to 6.1%.
Warrant conversions and ESOS exercises continue to increase issued share capital, potentially diluting earnings per share.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 September 2026, revenue was MYR 7,543,438,000, up 19.3% QoQ and 40.7% YoY; net income was MYR 460,619,000, up 8.8% QoQ but down 8.0% YoY; net margin was 6.1%, lower than 6.7% in the previous quarter.
